A traceable journey through the Double Diamond — every decision linked back to a user need, every gateway producing a locked artifact.

The Approach

From corporate strategy to traceable engineering execution

The framework uses a Double Diamond structure to bridge the gap between high-level corporate strategy and precise physical engineering execution. It systematically transforms unstructured qualitative customer struggles into quantified, traceable engineering boundaries and bill-of-materials specifications.

Quality Function Deployment acts as the core spine, translating the voice of the customer directly into functional, downstream product configurations. Rigid quality mechanisms like DFMEA are injected directly into the design phase to identify and mitigate hardware risks before physical prototyping occurs.

Locked artifact gateways sit between each milestone, forcing cross-functional accountability and preventing scope creep or arbitrary design pivots. Ultimately, the system establishes total back-propagation — allowing any manufacturing tolerance or production anomaly to be instantly traced back to the raw human need it satisfies.
